rules.disposition: Attach to related item or domain source provenance when a reliable relationship exists; otherwise retain as searchable source-reference evidence. Do not promote as an independent game object.
rules.evidence: Rows explicitly identify machine-detected mechanic occurrences, extraction method, confidence, source location, and canonical_status=source_reference_not_automatically_canon.

rules.disposition: Import as action candidates linked to their item_id. Preserve timing, use mode, range, target, effects, execution status, and source page.
rules.evidence: Rows carry action_id, item_id, action_name, timing, execution mode, range and target profiles, effect IDs, and execution status.

rules.disposition: Import as material assets using material_id as the stable identity while preserving all source-valued properties and non-executable status.
rules.evidence: Rows carry material_id, name, categories, environments, rarity, physical properties, uses, crafting roles, variant count, and execution status.

rules.disposition: Attach as material-to-use, crafting-role, trade, refinement-profile, and compatibility-profile relationships. Do not create a duplicate material object.
rules.evidence: Rows repeat material_id and name while expressing roles, uses, eligibility, and linked rules profiles.

conflictBehavior: The exact source payload remains authoritative. Do not merge variants, infer executable mechanics from source-valued fields, or discard unmapped fields.
boundary: Domain classification only. No production ledger is published, no identities are merged, no assets are promoted, and no source payload is rewritten or discarded.
